description: List active connection records for one Portkey-managed MCP server, including user, connected state, and connection timestamps. Use it to audit sessions or identify the user/workspace before disconnect_mcp_server_connection; service keys can list all users, while user keys default to their own user. Organisation admin keys must provide workspace_id. This reads live connection state and does not test upstream server reachability (use test_mcp_server for that).

id.description: MCP server ID or slug whose connections to list

page_size.description: Connections per page, from 1 through 500; defaults to 100

user_id.description: User UUID to filter; user-scoped keys default to their own user when omitted

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID or slug; required with an organisation admin API key

name: list_mcp_server_connections

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
